generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tender will not be considered
Tender application amount will not be refundable.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates excluding GST) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & Tender Transaction fee in the KPPP portal using any of the following payment modes. Credit Card, Direct Debit, National Electronic Fund Transfer, NEFT, and Over the Counter OTC.

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the KPPP portal. The uploaded documents should be clear (Visible), unclear documents will be rejected. The original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification.
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labor welfare fund.

The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificatesfromtheauthorizedqualitycontrolauthority,beforeexecution. Transportation charges from the site of work to Q.C. Lab of all the samples collected for testing should borne by the contractor himself

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted officer or Government Notary, otherwise the bids are liable for disqualification. Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. Work done certificates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year. All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent.
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment.
Royalty charges will be deducted from the contractors as per prevailing Government order at the time of payment.
The tender is invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW 3 and shall abide for the Conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW 3.
Price adjustment clause will not be applicable as per prevailing government order and only star rates for cement and steel are applicable as per prevailing GO No. PWD/159 CRM dt. 30.09.2010.
Bidder should quote the rates Excluding GST

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without thereby incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action.
IT, GST and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government order.

The contractor must upload existing commitment of the ongoing works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity. Action will be taken as per clause 26 of Section2. Instruction to tenderers (ITT) in case of incomplete/false documents regarding works in hand for calculation of tender capacity.
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No. FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bangalore dated.01-04-2023

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and Murrumetc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the workbill, then for such workbills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No. Ga. Bhu. E/ DCB/ DCB/ Takte/2019-20/4497 Dated. 12/12/2019 by Mines and Geology department
Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately as per the bid document.
Annual turnover certificate along with Balance sheet certificate/attested by Chartered accountants should be uploaded with 18-Digit system generated unique document identification number (UDIN).

Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities from banks for meeting the fund requirement should be submitted in the prescribed format as per the state government circular No. GO-FD-CAM/16/2022(P-2), Bangalore Dated.22-08-2022.
The Defects Liability Period is 365 Days after the completion of work.
The rates of concrete items are inclusive for formwork, shuttering, scaffolding and centering works.

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

Providing and fixing RCC precast fencing pole of size 0.15mx0.15mx2.0m casted in M 20 with 20mm down size aggregates making holes for drawing barbed wire at 30 cm c/c using 8 mm dia vertical 4 TMT steel rods and 6 mm dia stirups at 15 cm c/c fixed 1.5 m above Ground level using steel moulding , curing , transportation to work spot including excavation in all types of soil, fixing in plain cement concrete M15 using 20 mm downsize aggregate including aligning to plumb and line providing including cost of all materials, labour,usage charges of machinery complete.

Fencing  with  G.I. barbed wire R.C.C.  post  placed  at  required  distance, embedded  in  cement concrete blocks, every 15th post, last but one end post and corner post shall be strutted on both sides and end post one side only, provided with horizontal lines and two diagonals of barbed wire weighing 9.38 kg per 100 m (minimum), between the two posts fitted and fixed with G.I. staples on wooden plugs or G.I. binding wire tied to 6 mm bar nibs fixed while casting the post (cost of R.C.C. posts, struts, earth work and concrete to be paid for separately) :- Payment to be made per metre cost of total length of barbed wire used.

Removal of solid waste,building debris,Industrial waste and domestic waste from site to Nagarasabhe dumping yard / Panchayat dumping yard with all machinery , loading ,un-loading, Labour charges and material with all lead & lifts complete and as directed by the Engineer in charge.
